descriptionPlain:
About Us:
Docsumo is a Document AI software that helps enterprises automate document processing. We help enterprises convert documents such as invoices, ID cards & bank statements into actionable data. We are backed by marquee investors such as Sequoia, Fifth Wall, Common Ocean, Barclays, Techstars & Better Capital.
 
As a Senior Account Executive, you will be working independently as part of the Sales team. You will be directly working with the Founders and Director of Sales and get a hands-on role at enterprise sales for a growing global SaaS product.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will be working independently as part of the Sales team. You will be directly working with the Founders and Director of Sales and get a hands-on role at enterprise sales for a growing global SaaS product.

lists.content:
• Manage the entire sales cycle from finding a client to securing a deal, negotiating agreements, closing deals, and referrals/upselling.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations/demos, and proposals to the USA tech buyers.
  • Perform outbound sales activities including phone calls, emails, campaigns, and scheduling & facilitating demos.
  • Qualify inbound inquiries and appropriately advance them through the sales process.
  • Maintain strong rapport with existing customers, understanding their business needs and providing additional Docsumo solutions to optimize growth. 
  • Meet or exceed key sales activity metrics related to revenue pipeline in areas such as calls, emails, qualified opportunities, and secured demos to facilitate client acquisition and retention.
  • Cross-functional communication with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and other key stakeholders to provide feedback, and offer ideas on the best practices, successes, and product.
  • Maintain data accuracy of customer information in the CRM system to have proper reporting and analytics.

• Bachelors Degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales or business development roles with 2+ years in closing role.
  • Should have carried or held quota in earlier roles (preferably 50k-100k USD deals)
  • Should have sold to either ops or tech teams before
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate and present verbally and in writing.
  • Self-motivated, outgoing, and dedicated to achieve results within deadlines.
  • Growth mindset with the willingness to learn and develop professionally.
  • Knowledge of Excel/Word/Google Docs/Gmail/Hubspot/CRMs.
  • Must be a team player and is willing to go above & beyond.
  • Should have prior experience working with "C" & "D" level executives.
  • Should be comfortable working in EST zone (8 am to 5 pm EST)

additionalPlain:
Application Proces
Email the CEO of Docsumo with a video recording of yourself about your candidature & any other relevant details that you would like to share. Be brief - why sales, why startups, why Docsumo, what SaaS products do you use/admire, why you, anything else.
 
Please include in the title of your email BDR VIDEO APPLICATION - {Your Name}
 
In your email, please write list of 10 logos that you think would benefit from Docsumo & why.
 
We will review your submission, we will have 2 rounds of interviews with the founders, 1 mock call to see how you pitch on the phone and 1 written assessment on how you research & pitch over email.

descriptionPlain:
Company Description
Docsumo is a leading Document AI software solution designed to transform unstructured documents, such as invoices, bank statements, and tax returns, into structured and actionable data. Our technology enables businesses to automate document processing tasks, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort. With a focus on delivering accurate, scalable, and user-friendly solutions, Docsumo empowers global businesses to unlock the potential of their data for better decision-making. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent document automation.
 
Role Description
This is an on-site role for a Business Development Representative on a 6-month contract, specializing in B2B SaaS Sales. In this role, you will identify and generate leads, manage the sales pipeline, and conduct outreach to potential clients. You will nurture relationships with prospective customers, understand their business needs, and work closely with the sales team to convert leads into clients.

lists.content:
• As a Sales/Business Development Representative, you will work closely with management to identify new opportunities and reach out to potential customers via calls, email & LinkedIn to set up discovery calls.
  • Develop sales opportunities by researching and identifying potential accounts.
  • Handling all incoming customer queries on our live chat.
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospects through thoughtful follow-up and consistent engagement
  • Stay current with market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities
  • Maintain accurate and organized records in Hubspot
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to align strategies and messaging for effective lead generation and conversion

• Strong interest in launching a career in technology sales
  • Tenacious, self-starting mindset with a collaborative spirit
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Comfortable learning new tools and systems (Hubspot experience a plus)
  • Prior experience in sales or customer service preferred, but not required
  • Knowledge or interest in financial services
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Bonus - Experience with sales enablement or prospecting tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
